title: Tiny
text: Tiny. Bought these for a small 5ft Christmas tree and they're much too small to be seen. They're about the size of a postage stamp. The quality is fair, 2 of them didn't have an opening for a hook and several others had terrible paint jobs. Definitely not worth $15.
